Drinking very hot tea and coffee triples the risk of developing cancer of the gullet, the world’s largest study of the link between them has found.

The findings show that people should let very hot cups of tea and coffee cool down until they are comfortable to drink, in order to reduce their risk of the disease, cancer experts said.

Researchers said the differences, first detected at the age of one, could lead to cognitive problems when children started school.

articles.title: Dark energy debunked? Cosmic acceleration may be an illusion
articles.summary: A new analysis of more than 1,700 supernovae is questioning whether the universe is really accelerating at all.
